title: feat(audio): add voice processing support and microphone input improvements
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- **Lacks Platform-Level Voice Processing:** Godot previously lacked built-in support for hardware/OS-level voice processing features like Acoustic Echo Cancellation (AEC), Noise Suppression (NS), and Automatic Gain Control (AGC), making real-time voice chat susceptible to background noise and feedback loops.
- **Audio Capture Jitter and Buffer Precision Limitations:** Microphone input internally relied on `int32_t` precision, creating unnecessary format conversions and precision overhead. Applications also lacked a built-in mechanism to buffer capture jitter without causing stutters or audio dropouts.
- **Limited Input Diagnostics:** Games and applications had no clean built-in method to monitor live input peak levels or query whether an input device was operating in mono without manual buffer inspection.

## Solution Overview

- **Platform Voice Processing:** Exposed platform AEC, NS, and AGC settings via `ProjectSettings` configuration and programmatic `AudioServer` controls across supported platforms (macOS/iOS, Android, and Web).
- **Float Precision Buffer:** Upgraded the internal audio input pipeline from `int32_t` to native 32-bit `float` processing for cleaner signal processing and parity with output buffers.
- **Jitter Control:** Introduced `AudioStreamMicrophone.playback_delay_ms` to allow users to trade latency for capture jitter robustness.
- **Input Diagnostics:** Added `AudioServer.get_input_peak()` for input level metering and `AudioServer.is_input_mono()` for device topology checks.
- **Driver Updates:** Refactored CoreAudio, PulseAudio, WASAPI, OpenSL ES, and Web audio drivers to feed normalized floating-point samples to the engine.

## Additional information

- **Special Attention Needed:** Driver maintainers should verify buffer alignment for OpenSL and WASAPI driver fallbacks when platform FX filters are disabled.
- **Tested Platforms:** Verified audio capture and FX toggling on macOS, iOS, Android, Web, and Windows.
- **AI Disclosure:** AI was used to assist in formatting and structuring this PR description. All underlying code changes and driver updates were authored and tested manually.
